name: saidworks-skills
description: Free Claude Code skills for token audits, release checks and agent team health.

plugins.name: agent-token-auditor-lite
plugins.description: Shows where Claude Code tokens went, from your own local session logs. Free edition.

plugins.name: release-gate-lite
plugins.description: Free pre-release check for a git repository: secrets, version, changelog, merge markers, clean tree. One verdict: PASS, HOLD or FAIL.

plugins.name: agent-team-check-lite
plugins.description: Free health check for a team of agent sessions: roles, reporting lines, queues, plan and decision log.

plugins.name: lessons-log-lite
plugins.description: Free check for a LESSONS.md file of standing rules: evidence, review dates, rules with the same title, file size.

plugins.name: numbers-check-lite
plugins.description: Free check that every number in a report has a label, a source and a time.

plugins.name: research-brief-lite
plugins.description: Free check for a research brief: question, search budget, stop rule, a label on every claim, sources and dates.

plugins.name: cap-guard-lite
plugins.description: Free check of an agent's spend against a cap: spend so far, days left in the cycle and one verdict, OK, WARN or STOP.

plugins.name: connector-lock-lite
plugins.description: Free audit of the connector and MCP servers in your Claude Code settings: each server marked COVERED or OPEN.
